text_block_list.name: Speed synchrori
text_block_list.text: Hey, Franziska. This school is always so lively.

text_block_list.name: May Satake
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it hasn't changed in the past or even now. ...No, have you been doing better lately?

text_block_list.name: Speed synchrori
text_block_list.text: I think so too. The Twinkle Series has been more lively than ever in recent years.

text_block_list.name: Speed synchrori
text_block_list.text: The seeds I sowed back then, when I ran around desperately trying to reach the world... They're definitely sprouting now.

text_block_list.name: Speed synchrori
text_block_list.text: Of course, this isn't sentimentality. We're definitely living in the present. Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: May Satake
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'm still alive...and still dreaming.

text_block_list.name: Speed synchrori
text_block_list.text: That's right. I believe that the shining future inside here...will reach you. And beyond that...

text_block_list.name: Two.
text_block_list.text: ――I'll build a bridge over the world.

text_block_list.name: Speed synchrori
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh. Hey, May... The world's getting closer.

text_block_list.name: May Satake
text_block_list.text: ! ...Yeah. Just a little more... Just a bit more.

text_block_list.name: May Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Now then, let's continue talking about work. For the sake of our next greatest dream!
